data.narrative:
Traysar is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Yadin Soffer, Asher Katz, and Gilad Adin that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), supplemented by a broader universe of 10 comparable companies across public and private markets in defense and security infrastructure.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-Progression analysis, using total raised ($25M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier for Seed advancement, implies a valuation of $62M. Peer-Median analysis across the 3 direct comparables yields $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The disparity reflects variance in stage advancement and company maturity within the peer set.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $53M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $231M. The wide spread reflects fundamental uncertainty around Traysar's relative position within the Defense & Security ecosystem. The low-end anchors to conservative stage-based progression, while the high-end reflects peer medians inclusive of more mature Seed and Series A comparables. Key uncertainties include specific revenue or customer traction not provided in available data, and the appropriate discount or premium relative to the stated peer valuations.
